criteria.download: HTTP 2xx HTML page from the same site, decoded completely within the raw page limit and under 15 seconds.
criteria.extraction: Every required heading and anchor phrase (spread from start to end, including previously dropped policy text) is present; no listed site boilerplate is present.
criteria.ai: Runs the app's own pipeline (assessment, one targeted repair pass for unverifiable quotations, verification, scoring). Schema-valid output with all 10 categories and all 8 fixed regional checks; at least 90% of the final AI-supplied quotations match the source verbatim (word-for-word; only whitespace and curly-versus-straight quote marks may differ, and the stored excerpt is the exact source text), with the pre-repair rate also reported; every critical category is supported by a verified quotation; an overall score is produced; total time under 120 seconds.
